periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downwards and outwards.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Strongly oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering creating a teardrop profile, with the geometric center positioned above the midpoint of the vertical axis.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation between the medial edges of the ears, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous convex curvature at the superior boundary.
